subject: integration
name: Main account (this computer)
summary: Built-in Account: the recovery phrase is kept sealed by the OS keyring on this computer, and every key, signature and private-message call runs in a separate process whose imports and runtime are sealed against network use. It connects to nothing and relies on no server or party. The wallet's network reads are other rows. Level 4 with privacy; it would drop if a phrase or a signing step left the computer, or the signer gained a connection. Judged here by its publisher.
